Container.Name: mcp-ssh
Container.Overview: Custom SSH MCP server — exposes SSH access to a fleet of hosts as MCP tools over streamable-HTTP for AI agents, via a bundled ed25519 key. Generic and reusable: hosts are configured entirely through SSH_HOSTS below, nothing is hardcoded in the image. Mount your private key read-only into the container (see the SSH Key path below) and set ExtraParams to bind only to this server's Tailscale IP instead of all interfaces, e.g. -p YOUR_TAILSCALE_IP:8905:8905.

Config.Name: SUPERGATEWAY_PORT
Config.Description: Port inside the container — must match the container-side port in ExtraParams

Config.Name: SSH_HOSTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated hosts to expose, format name:host:username,name:host:username,... e.g. host1:192.168.1.10:admin,host2:192.168.1.11:admin

Config.Name: SSH Key
Config.Description: ed25519 private key for SSH access to your fleet
